description:
How many couple families are same-sex couples, and what share of couples that is: male and female couples, and those raising children, for every sizeable suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 5,300 suburbs and localities and 512 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with fewer than 100 couple families are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/same-sex-couples`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: couple_families_total, same_sex_couples_count, same_sex_couples_pct, male_same_sex_couples_count, male_same_sex_couples_pct, female_same_sex_couples_count, female_same_sex_couples_pct, same_sex_couples_with_children_count, same_sex_couples_with_children_pct, male_same_sex_couples_with_children_count, female_same_sex_couples_with_children_count. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_area_stats_same_sex_couples
title: Suburb · Same-sex couples
